scenes.title: What if we could compute with light?
scenes.body:
A short visual research update.
Start with one question. Make the idea clear.
scenes.narration: Can an optical network represent a matrix operation? This video illustrates a concept, not an experimental result.
scenes.label: 01 / THE QUESTION

scenes.title: Input x. Optical matrix W. Output Wx.
scenes.body:
Encode a signal, transform it in an optical network,
and measure the output. Then test the assumptions.
scenes.narration: An idealized linear optical network transforms an input vector. Real devices add noise, loss, and fabrication errors.
scenes.label: 02 / THE IDEA

scenes.title: Next: make room for uncertainty.
scenes.body:
Measure sensitivity to fabrication errors.
Compare against a fair baseline. Share what fails, too.
scenes.narration: The next step is sensitivity analysis. A good research update makes both evidence and uncertainty visible.
scenes.label: 03 / WHAT COMES NEXT
